## About
Davidson's Collision Center started as a one-man shop and has grown into a full collision repair center on Integrity Drive S in Columbus. We know how stressful an accident can be, so we focus on customer service you can rely on and treat your car with the same care we'd give our own.
Our technicians keep up with continuous training, and we work out of a multi-bay paint facility. Along with collision work, we handle dents, painting, touch-ups and bodywork.
Our customers have given us a 4.5 rating across 181 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision repair: After an accident, we work to get your car back to its pre-accident condition.
- Dents and dings: Minor dents and dings smoothed out without breaking the bank.
- Painting and touch-ups: A complete repaint or specific touch-ups, done in our paint shop.
- Bodywork: From scratches and scrapes to more extensive damage, handled with precision and care.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes. Contact us to schedule a free estimate.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: We do auto body work on both foreign and domestic cars and light trucks.

Q: When are you open?
A: We are open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM, and closed on weekends.
